article_title: Relationship between cognitive functioning and physical fitness in regard to age and sex.
citation: González-Fernández Francisco Tomás; Delgado-García Gabriel; Coll Jesús Siquier; Silva Ana Filipa; Nobari Hadi; Clemente Filipe Manuel. (2023). Relationship between cognitive functioning and physical fitness in regard to age and sex. BMC Pediatrics. https://doi.org/10.1186/s12887-023-04028-8
title: D2 attention test as the measure of selective attention and concentration
description: The D2 attention test is a paper-and-pencil measure of selective attention and concentration used to assess the students' cognitive functioning. It "consists of 14 rows of 47 characters each, with a total of 658 elements", where subjects cross the d's with two dashes, 20 seconds per row. Scores include TR, TA, O, C, TOT, CON, TR+, TR- and VAR, and the article reports test–retest reliability up to 0.90.
requirements: Administered individually or in classroom groups following the test's established protocol, with instructions explained by an education psychologist
target_learners: students aged 9–15 in primary and secondary school
examples: Used in the study with students completing 20-second rows marking target characters, scored on processed elements, successes, omissions and commissions
